reuse.why: Changes the existing isNonWorkingDay, which every weekend/holiday check in the tree already goes through, instead of adding matching anywhere else.

duplication.why: The MM-DD matching is written once in a small isHoliday helper.

placement.why: The rule lives in shared/schedules.ts beside the other schedule date predicates.

scope.why: Only the holiday predicate, a focused test and a release note are touched.

maintainability.why: A minimal, well-commented change in the single definition every caller uses.

bypasses_abstraction.where: All callers (getNextDate, getDateWithSkippedWeekend, schedule handlers) keep using isNonWorkingDay.
